name: Maryville College
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts college founded 1819 (over 200 years old), affiliated with the Presbyterian Church (USA). Offers 60+ majors and seven pre-professional programs on a 263-acre campus near the Great Smoky Mountains. Describes itself as a nationally-ranked institution; specific numeric ranking not published on reviewed pages.
financial_aid: 100% of undergraduate students receive financial aid (scholarships, grants, awards, or need-based assistance). On-campus scholarships range from $16,000 to full tuition. Source: maryvillecollege.edu tuition-and-fees page, 2026-2027 academic year.
facilities_notes: Softball plays home games on campus in Maryville, TN. Specific facility details (field name, seating) not published on reviewed athletics pages.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Collegiate Conference of the South (CCS). Finished the 2026 season with an 11-5 conference record and appeared in the CCS Championship tournament in Oxford, Alabama.
notes: Conference confirmed as Collegiate Conference of the South via 2026 schedule (games marked 'CCS'); some site footer text still references the Southern Athletic Association. Roster size (22) from softball roster page. Team social: X @mcscotssb, Instagram @mcscotssoftball. Data collected 2026-07 from mcscots.com and maryvillecollege.edu.
